title: Lunar Settlement
purpose: Establish a permanent Moon base with local extraction, processing, manufacturing, and cargo capability.
optimization_opportunities: Bring only startup essentials, establish local production early, and avoid importing every component from Earth.
infrastructure_reuse: Orbital power, cargo handling, research equipment, and Earth factories remain part of the lunar supply network.

milestones.title: Authorized Lunar Landing
final_validation: Land on the Moon only after Orbital Research completion.

milestones.title: Lunar Habitat
final_validation: Establish pressure, oxygen, thermal control, communications, and safe habitation.

milestones.title: Lunar Power Through Darkness
final_validation: Provide generation and storage capable of maintaining the base through a lunar darkness cycle.

milestones.title: Automated Lunar Mining
final_validation: Extract lunar resources automatically and deliver them to local processing.

milestones.title: Local Lunar Manufacturing
final_validation: Process lunar materials and manufacture a useful spacecraft or precision component locally.

milestones.title: Lunar Cargo Return
final_validation: Return cargo or establish an automated Earth-orbit-Moon supply route.

milestones.title: Functional Lunar Base
final_validation: Sustain habitation, local power, mining, processing, manufacturing, research readiness, and communications.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the base until environment and throughput triggers exist.
